facts.label: Name
facts.value: 海淀北东西大道 (今清华西路-颐和园路一线)

facts.label: In English
facts.value: The main east-west road south of the gardens (Tsinghua - 西苑 - 清漪园)

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a road outside the garden walls

facts.label: Where
facts.value: C: today's 清华西路 (osm way 23426778) and 颐和园路 (osm way 25686353) at 39.996; the AMS 1944 main road runs west on this line at 39.9964 (maps worker's affine, rms 95 m), then on along today's 二龙闸路 to the 颐和园

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Malone pp.68-69: 'the main east and west road' from which the branch to the 大宫门 turns off; p.17 (1930s) the motor road from Tsing Hua west to 香山. Wolseley p.228: 'the broad road, running parallel with the little river'.
